question.text: In the Gold Options example, with futures DSP at Rs 49,900, a call option with strike Rs 48,000 is:

answer.text: ITM — it will be automatically exercised unless contrary instruction is given

explanation.text: The Logic: Strike Rs 48,000 is below the futures DSP Rs 49,900, so the call is ITM. Per the workbook, ITM call options with strikes at or below the Gold futures DSP are auto-exercised unless contrary instruction is given. The Trap: The call is not OTM (that would require strike above 49,900). ATM would be strike = 49,900. The CTM category appears in Options on Goods, not in this Options on Futures example. Note: Auto-exercise is the default for ITM options on Gold futures unless the holder gives contrary instruction within the prescribed window.
